lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five vertical columns with three to four distinct spots per column in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the spot columns, where the circular blobs serve as high-luminance nodes centered within these vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transitioning from high luminance on the dorsal side to a shadowed edge below.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density field of smaller, less-defined high-luminance spots on the cephalic region and the presence of several dark, elongated biological attachments trailing from the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
